sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.source: MacOSX26.2.sdk CoreGraphics.framework/Headers, read directly by the author on this host.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.CGEventCreateMouseEvent: CG_EXTERN CGEventRef __nullable CGEventCreateMouseEvent(CGEventSourceRef __nullable source, CGEventType mouseType, CGPoint mouseCursorPosition, CGMouseButton mouseButton) API_AVAILABLE(macos(10.4));
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.eventSourceNullable: The event source may be taken from another event, or may be NULL.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.cursorPositionSemantics: 'mouseCursorPosition' should be the position of the mouse cursor in global coordinates.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.mouseButtonIgnored: 'mouseButton' is ignored unless 'mouseType' is one of 'kCGEventOtherMouseDown', 'kCGEventOtherMouseDragged', or 'kCGEventOtherMouseUp'.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.mouseButtonConsequence: A mouse-moved event is none of those three, so the button argument passed by the live seam is documented-ignored rather than meaningful, and no button state is introduced by this Issue.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.CGEventPost: CG_EXTERN void CGEventPost(CGEventTapLocation tap, CGEventRef __nullable event) API_AVAILABLE(macos(10.4));
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.CGEventPostReturnsVoid: The declaration returns void, so the SDK reports neither success nor failure of posting. This is the documented limitation recorded in the component document and is why the success value is named postRequested.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.CGEventPostSemantics: This function posts the specified event immediately before any event taps instantiated for that location, and the event passes through any such taps.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.tapLocations: typedef CF_ENUM(uint32_t, CGEventTapLocation) { kCGHIDEventTap = 0, kCGSessionEventTap, kCGAnnotatedSessionEventTap };
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.CGEventCreate: Return a new event using the event source 'source'. If 'source' is NULL, the default source is used.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.CGEventGetLocation: Return the location of an event in global display coordinates. CGPointZero is returned if event is not a valid CGEventRef.
sdkFactsVerifiedOnThisHost.readBackUsage: CGEventCreate plus CGEventGetLocation is how the Tier-H probe reads the current cursor position. It is used only by the default-skipped probe, never by production code and never by an automated assertion.
